story:
Raircon Corporation was founded in January 2002 in Orlando, Florida, with a straightforward goal: provide HVAC service that people could actually rely on. By 2006 the business had outgrown that base, and we moved our headquarters to Miami — a market that matched our ambitions and brought two additional corporate officers onto the team.

Over the two decades since, Raircon has delivered high-value projects in some of South Florida's most demanding locations, including Miami Beach, North Bay Village and Pembroke Pines. Our clients have included The Shelborne Beach Resort, Portofino Tower and 5600 Collins — properties where a mechanical failure is not an inconvenience but a business problem, and where the contractor's insurance, licensing and permitting have to be in order before anyone is allowed on site.

Responsiveness is something we built infrastructure for rather than something we advertise. Our fleet of 35 trucks is equipped with GPS, which lets us track and dispatch in real time from our central office in Hialeah. When a call comes in, dispatch sends the closest qualified technician instead of working down a list. That is the daily challenge of covering every service call across Miami-Dade, Broward and Monroe, and it is why our customers write about calls answered in seconds and technicians arriving within hours.

We hold licenses across mechanical, electrical, plumbing and construction, which means one company can carry a job from diagnosis through permitting to completion — no gap where a project stalls because two trades are waiting on each other. Today Raircon serves residential and commercial customers throughout South Florida with air conditioning, HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical, mechanical, construction and remodeling work. The aim on every one of them is the same as it was in 2002: find the actual problem, explain it plainly, and be the company you call again.
